hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the two-argument polygamma order family P(alpha,z)=polygamma(alpha,z). The two observed summands are obtained by specializing alpha to 0 and 1, respectively. The raw expression is therefore the sum of two adjacent specializations, and the derivative relation d/dz P(alpha,z)=P(alpha+1,z) links the two specializations.
required_assumptions: polygamma(alpha,z) is defined for alpha in {0,1} on the relevant domain
the derivative identity d/dz polygamma(alpha,z) = polygamma(alpha+1,z) holds for alpha=0
hypotheses.rationale: The raw expression is a sum of two successive polygamma orders. The reported LGG template polygamma(theta0,z) and the exact derivative relation are both captured by a single parameterized order family with parameter shift under z-differentiation.
